newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Truck sales fall 16 pct Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Truck sales fall 16 pct Jan-Oct.

text.p: The truck division of Swedish vehicle maker Volvo AB on Wednesday said sales in the first ten months of 1996 fell 16 percent to 53,170.
However in Europe Volvo Truck sales rose by six percent to 29,500 between January and the end of October.
Company spokesman Stefan Lorentzson told Reuters that Volvo's market share in Europe rose to 16.7 percent from 16 percent at the same time a year ago.
"The increase in deliveries and rise in our market share in Europe shows that our FH-series is an appealing product," Lorentzson said.
In North America where Volvo Truck has been struggling for some time, deliveries fell 39 percent to 14,300 trucks in the ten months.
In South America deliveries were also lower, falling 37 percent to 4,210.
